snippet.title: TRIOS - lofi beats / numbers to chill to - Switch + Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
TRIOS is a relaxing, minimalist maths puzzle game. Take your time, chill out with some numbers. Deceptively simple, surprisingly challenging.

Out now on Nintendo Switch and Steam! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1214060/TRIOS__lofi_beats__numbers_to_chill_to/
Switch: Link coming
Community: https://discord.gg/samuraipunk
